dedupe_keys.name: data from towards a functional understanding of rehabilitated urban road verge grasslands effects of planting year site conditions and landscape factors

description: Data from: Towards a functional understanding of rehabilitated urban road verge grasslands: Effects of planting year, site conditions, and landscape factors is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by open.bydata. Collected data from herbaceous vegetation plots across an urbanization gradient in road verges of Munich, Germany. Vegetation surveys were conducted to assess the cover of standing vegetation in existing road verges (controls) and in experimental plots after one year of sowing seed mixtures of native grasslands species. Coverage: open.bydata. The portal files it under the publisher open.bydata. Its tags are functional-ecology, road-verge-vegetation, urban-grassland, urban-roadsides. The portal shows 2026-09-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
